I found two issues in `main...review-head`. There's one real bug and one test-coverage gap. This commit only adds `average()` to `pricing.py`, and no CLAUDE.md applies to the repo. The other angles (removed behavior, callers, reuse, efficiency, altitude) turned up nothing: nothing was deleted, `average` has no callers yet, and swapping in `statistics.mean` would still fail on an empty list.
